facts.fact: 叙述者从小梦想睡四柱床，说这念头来自维多利亚时代的文学
facts.anchor: I have dreamed of sleeping in a canopy bed

facts.fact: Seth 说自己房间有壁炉，与楼下同一个烟囱，能听见楼下说话
facts.anchor: the same chimney as the one downstairs

facts.fact: 敲门的是 Seth，她下意识把浴袍两边拉紧
facts.anchor: I was not expecting to see Seth Caraway

facts.fact: Seth 追问 Marilyn 有没有评价他的演奏
facts.anchor: Did she say anything about my playing?

facts.fact: Seth 说想去 Meadowbank 的暑期音乐项目
facts.anchor: There’s one at the Meadowbank Institute I’d love to go to

facts.fact: 她点头承认 Marilyn 认为他能考进
facts.anchor: before I could stop myself, I was nodding

facts.fact: Seth 说母亲一直害怕会出事
facts.anchor: Always scared that something bad is going to happen

facts.fact: 章末她把整件事收成一句关于父母的格言
facts.anchor: it’s often the parents who see least clearly of all
